**Established:** 60 cm reflector (2017), 20 cm refractor for outreach. ~195 useful nights/year; 168 in 2024 (wet autumn). ~400 GB/month, nightly 40-min transfer to Marseille university server.

**Decided:** Main camera replaced March 2025 (cooling failed twice); 30% lower read noise. Firmware update pending—needs one full night offline.

**Failed/fixed:** 2023 dome motor seized; telescope hit dome wall, counterweight rod bent—replaced, limit switch added. Feb 2025: 1.2 s timestamp offset lost three weeks of photometry—now GPS-checked each session.

**Rules:** No runs during outreach evenings (2023 cause). Raw frames never deleted, compressed after two years. Acquisition software changes need a test night.

**Open:** Spanish simultaneous-observation collaboration (2025) awaits shared scheduling tool evaluation; network capacity for simultaneous transfers unknown.
